chains.title: TCF7L2-bound enhancer activates MYC
chains.element: rs6983267 lies in an allele-specific distal enhancer at 8q24; the ref G allele increases enhancer activity.
chains.cell_type: colorectal cancer epithelial cells, represented by HCT116

links.claim: TCF7L2 binds the ref G allele more strongly than the alt T allele at rs6983267; the G allele matches the TCF7L2/TCF4 motif and TCF7L2 is expressed in HCT116. No QBiC-SELEX evidence ID is supplied.
rs6983267 is in a distal enhancer whose activity is higher on the ref G allele.
The relevant cell type is colorectal cancer epithelium, represented by HCT116.
Higher TCF7L2 binding on the G allele increases MYC expression and raises colorectal cancer risk.

predictions: TCF7L2 ChIP is higher on G than T at this base.
An allele-specific enhancer reporter gives G > T activity in HCT116.
MYC expression is higher with G than T in an isogenic HCT116 background.
The G allele is the colorectal cancer risk allele.
falsified_if: The G allele does not show stronger TCF7L2 occupancy than the T allele in an allele-specific assay.
The G allele does not increase enhancer reporter activity or MYC expression in HCT116.
Loss of TCF7L2 does not reduce the G-allele-specific enhancer effect.

chains.title: TCF7L2-bound enhancer represses MYC
chains.element: rs6983267 lies in an allele-specific distal enhancer at 8q24; the ref G allele increases TCF7L2 occupancy but this occupancy is repressive.
chains.cell_type: colorectal cancer epithelial cells, represented by HCT116

links.claim: TCF7L2 binds the ref G allele more strongly than the alt T allele at rs6983267; the G allele matches the TCF7L2/TCF4 motif and TCF7L2 is expressed in HCT116. No QBiC-SELEX evidence ID is supplied.
rs6983267 is in a distal enhancer whose regulatory output is altered by TCF7L2 occupancy.
The relevant cell type is colorectal cancer epithelium, represented by HCT116.
TCF7L2 binding on the G allele represses MYC, and this context-dependent change raises colorectal cancer risk.

predictions: TCF7L2 ChIP is higher on G than T at this base.
An allele-specific enhancer reporter gives G < T activity in HCT116.
MYC expression is lower with G than T in an isogenic HCT116 background.
The G allele is still the colorectal cancer risk allele, but not through increased MYC.
falsified_if: The G allele increases rather than decreases enhancer reporter activity or MYC expression in HCT116.
TCF7L2 loss does not relieve repression on the G allele.

chains.title: No TCF7L2-mediated allelic effect at this base
predictions: No allele-specific TCF7L2 occupancy at rs6983267.
No allele-specific enhancer reporter activity for the isolated SNP.
No allele-specific MYC expression change when only rs6983267 is swapped.
Any colorectal cancer association is explained by a linked causal variant or another non-TF mechanism.
falsified_if: An allele-specific TCF7L2 occupancy assay shows G > T binding at this base.
An isolated rs6983267 G vs T enhancer reporter shows allele-specific activity in HCT116.
Isogenic allele replacement changes MYC expression in HCT116.

next_experiment: Allele-specific luciferase reporter containing the rs6983267 G or T enhancer plus a MYC promoter in HCT116 cells: G > T supports chain A, G < T supports chain B, and no allelic difference supports the null.
